item.title: Projects
item.description: Time Sensitive Networking (TSN) and Tactile Cyber-Physical Systems Design and implementation of a Tactile Cyber-Physical System (TCPS) for real-time interaction between humans and robots for applications requiring ultra-reliable low latency communication (uRLLC). To develop TSN enabled ethernet switches on programmable network hardware (Netronome Agilio SmartNIC) using P4 programmikng language. To implement time synchronization in the network to then setup a time sensitive network (TSN). This would involve implementing time aware shaper and gate control logic at the TSN switches’ ports.

item.title: About
item.description: Hello👋, I’m Nithish K Gnani Link to heading I’m a researcher at Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bangalore. I work with tactile internet, deterministic networks, cyber physical systems, IoT data management among other research areas in electronic systems. Experience Link to heading Project Associate, Centre for Networked Intelligence (CNI), IISc (2022-present) Project Associate, Department of Electronic Systems Engineering (DESE), IISc (2019-present) Team Leader, Supply Chain at Hindustan Coca-Cola Beverages Private Limited (2017-18) Education Link to heading Bachelor of Technology in Mechanical Engineering from National Institute of Technology (NIT) Karnataka, Surathkal, Karnataka, India
